dataController.heading: 1. Data Controller
dataController.body: This platform, developed as part of OBSS, processes your personal data within the scope described below.

processedData.heading: 2. Personal Data Processed
items: Usage data (interview answers, generated questions and assessment reports)

purposes.heading: 3. Purposes of Processing
items: Running the interview simulation and generating the assessment report

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal Basis
legalBasis.body: Your data is processed based on the legal grounds of contract formation/performance and legitimate interest, pursuant to Article 5 of Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK).

dataTransfer.heading: 5. Data Transfer
dataTransfer.body: The answers you give during the interview are shared with the Groq and DeepSeek AI service providers for the purpose of generating the assessment.

retention.heading: 6. Retention Period
retention.body: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active, and for 2 years after the assessment.

rights.heading: 7. Your Rights (KVKK Art. 11)
rights.body: Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your data is being processed, request information if it is, request correction or deletion, and object to the processing. You can send your requests to support@smart-interview.me.
